INCORRECT_DST_GROUP.desc: INCORRECT DST_GROUP FIELD IN TELEMETRY_CLIENT TABLE.

SRC_IP_INCORRECT_FORMAT.desc: Add src ip which is not in correct ip-prefix format.

DST_ADDR_INCORRECT_FORMAT.desc: Add dst_addr which is not in correct ip-port format.

DST_ADDR_IPV6.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed IPv6 host:port.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_MULTIPLE.desc: Add dst_addr mixing IPv4 and bracketed IPv6 host:port entries.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_UNBRACKETED.desc: Add dst_addr with an unbracketed IPv6 host:port, which is ambiguous.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_NO_PORT.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed IPv6 host but no port.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_BAD_HOST.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed host that is not an IPv6 address.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_V4_EMBEDDED.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed IPv4-embedded IPv6 host (RFC 4291 2.2).

DST_ADDR_IPV6_ZONE.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed zone-scoped link-local IPv6 host.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_TOO_MANY_GROUPS.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed host of sixteen groups around '::'.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_NINE_GROUPS.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed host of eight groups plus '::'.

DST_ADDR_IPV6_TWO_DOUBLE_COLONS.desc: Add dst_addr with a bracketed host that compresses twice.

DST_ADDR_NO_SEPARATOR.desc: Add dst_addr with two endpoints and no comma between them.

DST_ADDR_TRAILING_COMMA.desc: Add dst_addr with a trailing comma after the last endpoint.
